text:
Priya R.: Helix onboard — getting intermittent 429s during SDK init in staging. Customer will demo tomorrow; need quick mitigation. Logs show a burst when their CI spins up ~40 workers.
Samir K.: Can you paste the exact error lines? Is this TLS/mtls or token refresh? 429 body usually contains rate_limit info.
Priya R.: snippet: `{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":0.5}` from /v1/sdkgateway/preflight — they call `/init` concurrently.
Marta L.: If it's concurrent init, add jitter + exponential backoff client-side. Suggest limiting parallel init to 8. Also check ephemeral token TTL; short TTL can cause refresh storms.
Diego (eng): Agree. Also on our side I can enable a short grace window for that org to reduce immediate 429s. Need org id.
Priya R.: Org: helix-inc-42. I can get their init payload. Looping them in Slack after 2pm call.
Samir K.: Quick try: on client, set `MAX_PARALLEL_INIT=8` and stagger startup with `sleep rand(0,1.2)` — that'll massively cut preflight fanout.
Priya R.: Noted. Marta — any console flags we can tweak temporarily?
Marta L.: I can open a rollout: `rdw:config set helix-inc-42 preflight_coalesce=true` — that'll queue close-in-time requests into one coalesced preflight. Temp until they stabilize.
eng-alert-bot: Alert recorded: rate_limit spikes for org helix-inc-42 between 17:02-17:08 UTC, peak RPS 68.
Priya R.: Thanks. I'll send implementation checklist to Helix and report back after their 3pm test.
Samir K.: If they still get 429s, collect `x-rdw-ratelimit-remaining` and `x-rdw-ratelimit-reset` headers and paste here.
Priya R.: Will do. Also asked them to share SDK version and whether they use our JS browser or node embedder.
Diego (eng): FYI I'll stage the coalesce flag now for canary (10% traffic) and monitor.
Marta L.: Thx. If canary looks good we'll flip to 100% for helix-inc-42. Recommend keeping `preflight_coalesce` until they've reduced parallelism.
Priya R.: Update 17:32 UTC — Helix lowered parallel init to 6, ran 3 tests, no 429s so far. Will keep monitoring.
Samir K.: Nice. Follow-up: ask them to implement token splay at refresh to avoid TTL bump storms. Share link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/init-best-practices
Priya R.: On it. Closing after 24h steady state, will reopen if anything resumes. :thumbsup:
